description: This PHP class defines a validation rule for province codes within the OrangeHRM system, ensuring that provided input corresponds to a valid Province entity using services injected via a trait.

classes.name: ProvinceCode
classes.description: A validation rule class that checks if a given province code exists and maps to a Province entity.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates whether the input is a valid province code, returning true if the code maps to an existing Province, false otherwise.
